 Sergio Ros Mohamed Mansi Oct 24, 2026 09:27-05:00 Translated by A Barcelona star on the table of an Italian giant in the winter transfer window
 Transfers LaLiga Serie A Barcelona Roma A. Balde Spain Italy Serie A opens its doors to Baldé
 Alejandro Balde's future is back in the spotlight after the Barcelona full-back lost part of his standing in Hansi Flick's plans this season. 
 According to Sport , the player's agent Jorge Mendes is already working through the options to find Balde a new home. One of those options, which has emerged in recent hours, points to Italy. 
 Italian newspaper "Il Messaggero" claims Mendes has offered Balde to Roma, who are weighing up a swoop in the January window. 
 Gian Piero Gasperini wants to strengthen at left-back, and Roma reckon Balde fits the bill.

 The proposed deal would see the player loaned until the end of the current season, with a clause handing the Italian club an option to buy. 
 That structure suits both sides. Roma would land Balde without stumping up a big fee straight away, while Barcelona would keep the door open to a sizeable sum from a sale next summer. 
 It is not the first time Balde has been linked with a move to Serie A. Juventus also sounded out a deal a few weeks ago. 
 Sport revealed at the end of last September that Juventus were mulling a loan with an option to buy. Barcelona's valuation of around 50 million euros proved a major stumbling block to getting it done.
